road_centerlines.description: City and ETJ road centerlines; maintained with road additions, removals, street-name and block-range changes.
road_centerlines.caveat: The source describes itself as maintained and most up-to-date for Houston and its ETJ, but disclaims warranty of accuracy/completeness for specific applications.

intersection_nodes.use: Reference intersection and special node layer; do not assume its identifiers directly match COH_RoadCenterline without a verified crosswalk.

network_links.use: Supplemental city network-link reference; keep separate from centerlines until link-to-centerline correspondence and routing semantics are verified.

spatial_model.road_segments: Continuous polyline geometry; no grid snapping.
spatial_model.topology: Build/validate edge-node incidence, crossing connectivity, and grade separation before enabling Kernel pathfinding.
spatial_model.directionality: Preserve onewaydir raw values; decode only after source-domain validation.
spatial_model.speed_and_lanes: Preserve source values and types; do not infer operational limits from unvalidated values.
spatial_model.stable_identity: AO-owned deterministic ID derived from source GlobalID; retain OBJECTID and centerlineid as source identifiers.
spatial_model.provenance: Every imported feature retains source URL, layer, source IDs, source edit timestamp, acquisition timestamp, source CRS, transformation, and snapshot hash.

acquisition.method: Capture stable source OBJECTID set, download in bounded batches, transform server output to EPSG:4326, validate geometry and IDs, compare source edit timestamp before/after, write atomically.
acquisition.current_state: Full filtered road snapshot acquired and endpoint graph built in successful CI; verified downloadable artifact exists. Snapshot/graph remain staging artifacts and have not been imported into AO's canonical spatial registry.

usage_limits: Road centerlines are not lane-level driving geometry.
Centerlines alone do not establish sidewalk or pedestrian access.
One-way, access, turn restrictions, bridges, tunnels, and grade-separated crossings need validated network semantics.
Official Nodes and Links are supplemental datasets and are not yet crosswalked to centerline IDs.
Do not treat road graph routing as physical Envoy movement; the Kernel remains the authority for movement resolution.
